coverage: Ready requires exact installation at entry and final commit; missing/lost installation or SQL write refusal leaves no durable change.
The Store retains its installation guard until the ready transaction is visible to an independent SQL reader.
Only an exact captured current pending target is temporarily refused; reserved/uncertain state and target revocation cannot gain activation.

Known moved targets stopped before activation settle without a public Ready state/event; new and claimed candidates retire with fenced generations, retained routes stay current, and duplicate settlement is idempotent.
failure_and_correction: The initial stopped projection inserted retired state before immutable admission/lifetime binding. Existing lifetime triggers require the original captured ready admission. The correction records that historical admission and its retirement within one transaction; only retired state and retirement journal facts become visible. No schema constraint was relaxed.
limitations: Store fixtures use metadata-only installation/absence observers. These results do not exercise actual Service/Core movement or physical termination races.
Service compile checks are not runtime evidence. Actual Service removal/termination, Data observer failures and restart reconciliation still require focused integration proof.
No new full media workload, mixer/Store writer-drain proof, video-bootstrap/epoch proof or complete transport cell.
